```python
def review(*, report: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, params: Optional[Dict[
    str, Any]]=None) ->tuple:
    SafetyContext().command = 'review'
    
    vulns = []
    remediations = defaultdict(dict)
    packages = {}
    
    if not report:
        return vulns, remediations, packages
    
    meta = report.get('meta', {})
    db_full = report.get('db', None)
    
    for pkg_data in report.get('packages', []):
        pkg = Package(
            name=pkg_data['name'],
            version=pkg_data.get('version', None),
            requirements=[SafetyRequirement(r) for r in pkg_data.get('requirements', [])],
            found=pkg_data.get('found', None),
            insecure_versions=pkg_data.get('insecure_versions', []),
            secure_versions=pkg_data.get('secure_versions', []),
            latest_version=pkg_data.get('latest_version', None),
            latest_version_without_known_vulnerabilities=pkg_data.get('latest_version_without_known_vulnerabilities', None),
            more_info_url=pkg_data.get('more_info_url', None)
        )
        packages[pkg.name] = pkg
    
    for vuln_data in report.get('vulnerabilities', []):
        pkg_name = vuln_data.get('package_name', '')
        pkg = packages.get(pkg_name, None)
        req = SafetyRequirement(vuln_data.get('analyzed_requirement', ''))
        
        cve_data = vuln_data.get('CVE', None)
        cve = None
        if cve_data and isinstance(cve_data, dict):
            cve = CVE(name=cve_data.get('name', ''), cvssv2=cve_data.get('cvssv2', None), cvssv3=cve_data.get('cvssv3', None))
        
        severity = None
        severity_data = vuln_data.get('severity', None)
        if severity_data and isinstance(severity_data, dict):
            severity = Severity(source=severity_data.get('source', ''), cvssv2=severity_data.get('cvssv2', None), cvssv3=severity_data.get('cvssv3', None))
        
        vuln = Vulnerability(
            vulnerability_id=vuln_data.get('vulnerability_id', ''),
            package_name=pkg_name,
            pkg=pkg,
            ignored=vuln_data.get('ignored', False),
            ignored_reason=vuln_data.get('ignored_reason', None),
            ignored_expires=vuln_data.get('ignored_expires', None),
            vulnerable_spec=set(vuln_data.get('vulnerable_spec', [])),
            all_vulnerable_specs=vuln_data.get('all_vulnerable_specs', []),
            analyzed_version=vuln_data.get('analyzed_version', None),
            analyzed_requirement=req,
            advisory=vuln_data.get('advisory', None),
            is_transitive=vuln_data.get('is_transitive', False),
            published_date=vuln_data.get('published_date', None),
            fixed_versions=vuln_data.get('fixed_versions', []),
            closest_versions_without_known_vulnerabilities=vuln_data.get('closest_versions_without_known_vulnerabilities', []),
            resources=vuln_data.get('resources', []),
            CVE=cve,
            severity=severity,
            affected_versions=vuln_data.get('affected_versions', []),
            more_info_url=vuln_data.get('more_info_url', '')
        )
        vulns.append(vuln)
    
    remediations = calculate_remediations(vulns, db_full)
    
    return vulns, remediations, list(packages.values())


def read_vulnerabilities(fh: Any) ->Dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return json.load(fh)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        raise MalformedDatabase(reason=e)
    except TypeError as e:
        raise MalformedDatabase(reason=e)
```
